mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, status, total_amount_cents, currency, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{totalAmountCents}, #{currency}, #{idempotencyKey})

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, package_id, product_title, shop_name, package_name, access_policy, unit_price_cents, currency, quantity ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{packageId}, #{productTitle}, #{shopName}, #{packageName}, #{accessPolicy}, #{unitPriceCents}, #{currency}, #{quantity} )
